description: Source code for linux_ptrace_dumper.cc, part of Google Breakpad, implementing process memory dumping and thread management via ptrace on Linux.

classes.name: LinuxPtraceDumper
classes.description: Class for dumping process memory and thread info on Linux using ptrace.

classes.name: ThreadInfo
classes.description: Structure holding thread-specific information such as ppid, tgid, registers, and stack pointer.

methods.name: CopyFromProcess
methods.description: Reads memory from a process using ptrace PEEKDATA.

methods.name: GetThreadInfoByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves thread info from /proc/<tid>/status and ptrace registers.

methods.name: IsPostMortem
methods.description: Indicates if the dump is post-mortem; returns false.

methods.name: ThreadsSuspend
methods.description: Suspends all threads of the process via ptrace.

methods.name: EnumerateThreads
methods.description: Lists all thread IDs of the process from /proc/<pid>/task.
